parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The consumer group ID. After you call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call [QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~) to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: NewGroupName
parameters.description: The new name of the consumer group. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character is counted as two characters.
